verses.text: A song. A Psalm of the sons of Korah. Great is the LORD, and greatly to be praised in the city of our God, His holy mountain.

segments.text: A song. A Psalm of the sons of Korah. Great is the LORD, and greatly to be praised in the city of our God, His holy mountain.

verses.text: Beautiful in loftiness, the joy of all the earth, like the peaks of Zaphon is Mount Zion, the city of the great King.

segments.text: Beautiful in loftiness, the joy of all the earth, like the peaks of Zaphon is Mount Zion, the city of the great King.

verses.text: God is in her citadels; He has shown Himself to be a fortress.

segments.text: God is in her citadels; He has shown Himself to be a fortress.

verses.text: For behold, the kings assembled; they all advanced together.

segments.text: For behold, the kings assembled; they all advanced together.

verses.text: They saw and were astounded; they fled in terror.

segments.text: They saw and were astounded; they fled in terror.

verses.text: Trembling seized them there, anguish like a woman in labor.

segments.text: Trembling seized them there, anguish like a woman in labor.

verses.text: With a wind from the east You wrecked the ships of Tarshish.

segments.text: With a wind from the east You wrecked the ships of Tarshish.

verses.text: As we have heard, so we have seen in the city of the LORD of Hosts, in the city of our God: God will establish her forever. Selah

segments.text: As we have heard, so we have seen in the city of the LORD of Hosts, in the city of our God: God will establish her forever. Selah

verses.text: Within Your temple, O God, we contemplate Your loving devotion.

segments.text: Within Your temple, O God, we contemplate Your loving devotion.

verses.text: Your name, O God, like Your praise, reaches to the ends of the earth; Your right hand is full of righteousness.

segments.text: Your name, O God, like Your praise, reaches to the ends of the earth; Your right hand is full of righteousness.

verses.text: Mount Zion is glad, the daughters of Judah rejoice, on account of Your judgments.

segments.text: Mount Zion is glad, the daughters of Judah rejoice, on account of Your judgments.

verses.text: March around Zion, encircle her, count her towers,

segments.text: March around Zion, encircle her, count her towers,

verses.text: consider her ramparts, tour her citadels, that you may tell the next generation.

segments.text: consider her ramparts, tour her citadels, that you may tell the next generation.

verses.text: For this God is our God forever and ever; He will be our guide even till death.

segments.text: For this God is our God forever and ever; He will be our guide even till death.
